host: Windows with Go 1.27.3 and a local TEI checkout
command: go run ./tools/reference-generator-selection/cmd/tei-generator-build -contract <TAI>/integrations/pilot-sui-document/candidates/{island-record,edge-record}/contract.json -strategy text-record-template -out <tmp> && go run ./tools/reference-generator-selection/cmd/tei-generator-select ... && go run ./tools/reference-target-profile/cmd/tei-target-profile run -profile <TAI>/integrations/pilot-sui-document/profiles/record.json ...

observed.relationRepresentation: fromCard and toCard are identifier fields in one flat record; the relation is a std.code field.
observed.documentComposition: deferred: the text-record contract is flat and cannot nest cards, islands, or edges.

scope: Two reference-local record contracts for SUI Island and Edge, each generated, selected against four fixtures, and run under the one-shot record profile. It does not produce nested Document projection, SUI code, real target deployment, or human acceptance.
